notes.title: Blind Fate: Edo no Yami Dojo Steam Deck Compatibility Update
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We've been getting a lot of questions regarding Steam Deck Compatibility for our game. And the answer is finally here! 

We've just got the notice from Valve's testing team, and now we're ready to officially announce that our game is fully functional on Steam Deck!

If you're experiencing any troubles playing the game on Steam Deck or any other platform, feel free to share your feedback with us in our [url=https://discord.gg/troglobytes]Discord server[/url].

Thanks!

notes.title: Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo first patch
notes.content:
Hey, warriors!

We stand ready to deploy a small patch to improve your gaming experience. The update will become available today, and it’ll be very helpful if you can re-install Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo and try it once again to feel the difference. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41617319/1e329e4a26eadf9f95305a1bb5882c7a4b148527.jpg[/img]

Here's the list of changes:

1. Players can now skip tutorial challenges available in the Dojo (aka the training room).

2. Fixed a bug at the end of the very first boss fight. Some players surprised us with screenshots of a weird-looking 3D model of the boss standing behind Yami during a cutscene at the end of the first boss fight. If you happened to experience it, sweat no more — we found what caused it and fixed it.

3. Uncapped frame rate settings hotfix. Want to take full advantage of your 144Hz monitor? Go to the Settings in Menu and enable the unlimited FPS rate to let the game render as fast as possible. 

4. Improved Heavy Kami's hammer animations. When fighting with Heavy Kami (the big guy with a darn heavy hammer) you could notice that his hammer sometimes didn't match his body posture and moves. We went ahead and changed it so that now his weird body language won't distract you from surviving the fight.  

Hopefully, these changes will make your gaming experience even more pleasant, and also we'd like to thank everyone who filled out a survey form as well as all who left feedback on Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo in Discord, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294880/Blind_Fate_Edo_no_Yami/]Steam[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/_Troglobytes_]Twitter[/url]. Without you, we wouldn’t have found some nasty bugs and come up with some great ideas. There is much more to implement and improve before the launch of the game, and we hope you will stay with us to make Blind Fate: Edo no Yami even better together!

Add Blind Fate: Edo no Yami to your wishlist and subscribe to our news so that you don't miss the upcoming events, updates, and contests.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294880/Blind_Fate_Edo_no_Yami/

notes.title: Thank you for playing Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo
notes.content:
Hey everyone! In this short post, we’d like to thank you for your continued support and interest in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832220]Blind Fate: Edo no Yami[/url] game. Over the few days, we’ve received some reviews on Steam and we’re so grateful for your kind words as well as solid critique. You've given us plenty of well thought out points and this means the world for a small crew like ours.

[previewyoutube=ZefNtcr-vmY;full][/previewyoutube]

You might have noticed that we changed the name from Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Prologue to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832220]Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo[/url]. Why? The term "dojo" literally means "place of the Way" in Japanese and usually, it is a safe place to train or meditate. This is exactly the experience we wanted to provide in this game fragment.

As this is a free version of the game, writing reviews is one way you can give back and contribute to the community. We believe it might help other users to make an informed decision if it’s worth or not playing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832220]Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo[/url] and help us to grow. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832220

If you have finished [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832220]Blind Fate: Edo no Yami — Dojo[/url], feel free to leave a review on Steam and ask us anything regarding the game’s lore, mechanics, or whatever else is on your mind in Steam Discussions. 
Also, consider joining any of our dedicated social media communities

* [url=https://www.facebook.com/games101xp]Facebook[/url], 
* [url=https://twitter.com/_Troglobytes_]Twitter[/url], 
* [url=https://discord.gg/pFgcs432qe]Discord[/url]
* [url=https://vk.com/edonoyami]VK[/url].

Blind Fate: Edo no Yami is slated for a Q1-Q2 2022 release on PC and consoles, and we’ll definitely announce more accurate information on the official Blind Fate: Edo no Yami Steam page. Please, make sure you wishlisted the game if you would like to be notified when that happens.
